research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: frozen official occupations, MP biography, parliamentary speeches2023/2024, state grant recipient record, contemporary2015/2018 media, full-time/professional and historical state-security searches. WA2009 committee PDF and MCNews direct fetch403; West2021 source subscription-only, not bypassed. Namesake ACT health and UK employment results excluded.

Priority: public-service graduate-entry date and all pre2001 work; DPC appointment/title dates and workload, native-title/security assignments; Woodside substantive full-time status, leave and2019 cessation; 2019–20 gap and ministerial2020–21 dates.

Verify secondary full-time Beelu claim against primary employer evidence, distinguish managing duties from board/shareholding, obtain exact active-work and directorship cessation. Speech12August2024 narrows end to before that date but does not justify an exact end or continuous full-time2021–24. Resolve electoral2022 overlap and any unpaid breaks.

Find Motorcycling Australia/Oceania annual reports for board tenure and payment status; personal motorcycling is not automatically employment. Record last attempted avenues before later follow-up, rather than repeating inaccessible articles.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: MA 2016 audited report resolves director election/resignation and nil remuneration; FIM 2016 yearbook corroborates Oceania presidency. Neither sporting presidency is paid commercial employment. MA 2017 report also examined; do not confuse successor president start with Lawrence resignation.

First speech confirms after-school paid work from age 14 and a later period with UNHCR Bangladesh; employment details are missing, not zero. Army Reserve service in official biography newly recorded without invented dates or hours. Party vice-presidency recorded separately.

Next: DPC personnel/title history to reconcile 2000 annual-report biography with 2001 principal-policy span; military service statement and early employer/UNHCR placement evidence; Woodside leave and dated Beelu workload evidence. Searches again located secondary full-time distillery assertion but no primary interval proof. Public 2021 distillers association membership observation is not employment commencement.
